title: Restrict a first-page spectral sequence to its second page
statement: Let $B$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] and let $E$ be a first-quadrant cohomological spectral sequence [def-sp-spectral-sequence] starting at $E_1$. Define its restriction starting at $E_2$ by retaining exactly the pages $E_r$ for every $r\ge2$ and the same page-homology identifications. This changes only the starting page, and retains all page objects and differentials.
